verdict: Strong ad returns this period, but local search presence needs attention.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Meta ads returned $5.58 for every $1.00 spent — and in the most recent week, that return climbed another 19% while purchases rose 25% week-over-week. Google Business Profile activity, however, dropped 62% in the last 7 days, with profile actions falling to zero on three consecutive days, which points to a breakdown in local discovery that is being investigated and resolved now. Revenue figures show some day-to-day unevenness that is likely a tracking gap between your store and the ad platform; a fix is in progress so the data reflects the full picture going forward. With the September 30 milestones — automation flows, subscribe pages, and your first monthly report — all due next week, the account moves into a more complete setup phase.
